# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary analysis documents generated as part of the application assessment for the **PhotoGallery** project (ASP.NET MVC 5 / .NET Framework 4.8 web application backed by Azure Blob Storage).

## Supplementary Documents

| Document | Description |
|---|---|
| [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) | Application architecture diagram showing layers, technology stack, and component relationships with Mermaid flowcharts |
| [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) | Visual map of all declared external NuGet dependencies grouped by functional category, with version risk analysis |
| [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) | Inventory of all MVC action endpoints, communication patterns, security posture, and service interaction sequence diagram |
| [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) | Data persistence layer documentation covering Azure Blob Storage configuration, access patterns, and data sensitivity analysis |
| [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) | Comprehensive inventory of configuration sources, build and runtime profiles, property keys, secrets handling, and framework versions |
| [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) | Core business workflows (browse, upload, delete images) with domain entity mapping, business rules, and end-to-end sequence diagrams |
